name: Moon Princess

features.name: Princess powers
features.description: Three princesses trigger random powers: diamond creation, symbol removal or grid transformation.

features.name: Trinity Reels
features.description: Free spins with all three powers available.

review:
An anime cascading grid with three princess powers that can trigger at random on any spin – each one changes the board in its own way, so you never quite know what's coming.

The free spins bring a multiplier that grows with every cascade. A dependable mid-2010s game whose presentation has aged pretty well. High volatility, 5,000x max and 96.5% RTP.
